name: Marqii
oneLiner: Digital operations platform for restaurants that keeps menus, listings, reviews and social posts up to date from one dashboard, with POS menu sync, AI-suggested review replies and review generation.
bestFor: Multi-location restaurant brands and franchisees that want menu and listing accuracy plus review response handled in one restaurant-specific tool, with published per-location pricing.

updates.text: Launched Social Management for scheduling posts to Facebook and Google Business Profile from Marqii, with more channels and features planned.
Launched First Party Reviews: branded review forms shared by link, QR code or website embed, with results included in Marqii's review insights.
Launched Review Generation with Thanx: after a purchase, Marqii sends guests a text inviting them to review the restaurant on Google, Facebook or TripAdvisor.

features: Menu management that syncs POS menu changes to Google, Yelp and other sites
Listings management for hours, photos, offers and contact details
Review inbox for Google, Yelp, Facebook, OpenTable, Uber Eats, Grubhub, ezCater and more
AI-suggested review replies, plus a managed review response service for high-volume brands
First-party review forms and SMS review requests after a purchase
Social post scheduling for Facebook and Google Business Profile

pricing.text: Published per location per month on an annual contract: Base (menus and location data) $74.99, Pro (adds reviews) $119.99, Kitchen Sync (adds advanced reviews) $149.99. Add-ons: AI-suggested review responses $15 and social management $20 per location per month. Custom pricing for large multi-unit accounts.

notes: Pricing figures come from search-result snippets of marqii.com/pricing (WebFetch blocked); confirm before publishing. Marqii claims 15,000+ restaurants on its homepage (an older page says 12,000); vendor figure, not used. Case-study metrics (e.g. Romulus 94% response rate) are vendor-reported. Nothing in the current review was found to be wrong; the review spells the name 'Marquii' once, which should be 'Marqii'.
